notes.title: Update 1.4.2976 Released
notes.notes: This is a small maintenance release which updates the engine libraries with bug fixes and performance improvements. It also make some small changes to the menu artwork. Happy mowing!

notes.title: Update 1.1.2947 Released for macOS and Windows
notes.notes: This is a small update which fixes the achievement 'Braved the Weather' being awarded when completing the Autumn maps. Sorry about that! We've also had a lot of positive feedback, as well as a few suggestions so some of those will be implemented in a future update coming soon. Thank you for playing, happy mowing!
